actions.script:
StringBuilder csv = new StringBuilder() csv.append('﻿') csv.append("Cash Flow Statement
") csv.append("Organization: ${orgName}
") csv.append("Period: ${periodName ?: 'Current'}

") csv.append("Particulars,Amount (${currSymbol})

")
csv.append("A. CASH FLOW FROM OPERATING ACTIVITIES,,
") csv.append("Net Profit before Tax,"${ec.l10n.format(netProfitBeforeTax, '#,##0.00')}"
") for (def adj : operatingAdjustments) csv.append(""${adj.name}","${ec.l10n.format(adj.amount, '#,##0.00')}"
") csv.append(""Cash Generated from Operations","${ec.l10n.format(cashFromOperations, '#,##0.00')}"
") for (def wc : workingCapitalChanges) csv.append(""${wc.name}","${ec.l10n.format(wc.amount, '#,##0.00')}"
") csv.append(""Net Cash from Operating Activities (A)","${ec.l10n.format(netCashOperating, '#,##0.00')}"

")
csv.append("B. CASH FLOW FROM INVESTING ACTIVITIES,,
") for (def inv : investingItems) csv.append(""${inv.name}","${ec.l10n.format(inv.amount, '#,##0.00')}"
") csv.append(""Net Cash from Investing Activities (B)","${ec.l10n.format(netCashInvesting, '#,##0.00')}"

")
csv.append("C. CASH FLOW FROM FINANCING ACTIVITIES,,
") for (def fin : financingItems) csv.append(""${fin.name}","${ec.l10n.format(fin.amount, '#,##0.00')}"
") csv.append(""Net Cash from Financing Activities (C)","${ec.l10n.format(netCashFinancing, '#,##0.00')}"

")
csv.append(""Net Increase/(Decrease) in Cash (A+B+C)","${ec.l10n.format(netCashChange, '#,##0.00')}"
") csv.append(""Opening Cash & Cash Equivalents","${ec.l10n.format(openingCash, '#,##0.00')}"
") csv.append(""Closing Cash & Cash Equivalents","${ec.l10n.format(closingCash, '#,##0.00')}"
")
ec.web.response.setContentType("text/csv; charset=utf-8") ec.web.response.setHeader("Content-Disposition", "attachment; filename="CashFlowStatement.csv"") ec.web.response.writer.write(csv.toString()) ec.web.response.writer.flush()
